newsitem.title: UK: UK PSBR influenced by special factors - Treasury.
newsitem.headline: UK PSBR influenced by special factors - Treasury.

text.p: April UK PSBR data should be viewed with caution as they are influenced by special factors, the Treasury said.

"One should not read too much into one month's figures at the start of the financial year. The PSBR in April should be viewed with caution as it is flattered by a number of special factors including a one-off benefit of 1.25 billion pounds of asset sales and changes to quarterly VAT payments for big companies," a spokesman said.

Data showed a public sector surplus of 36 million stg in April. Analysts had expected, on average, a deficit of 1.7 billion. "The Chancellor is determined to see a significant further progress before he is confident that public finances are on a sounder long-term footing," the spokesman said.
